name: [mccp] Agent token budget — {{gen_ai.agent.id.name}}
message:
Agent {{gen_ai.agent.id.name}} used {{value}} tokens in the last hour (threshold {{threshold}}).
Datadog alerts; the Azure API Management gateway enforces. The webhook calls the kill-switch Logic App, which adds the agent to the APIM named value `killed-agents`.
{{#is_alert}}@webhook-mccp-killswitch{{/is_alert}} @ai-platform@contoso-health.example
_notes: VALIDATE: the metric name Datadog stores for the OTel histogram gen_ai.client.token.usage (histograms may map to a distribution or .sum/.count series depending on exporter settings).
VALIDATE: tag key gen_ai.agent.id is kept as-is by the Datadog exporter.

Create the webhook integration 'mccp-killswitch' with the Logic App callback URL (contains a SAS signature: store it only in the Datadog webhook integration, never in git) and the payload in datadog/webhook_payload.json.
Create via API: POST https://api.<DD_SITE>/api/v1/monitor with DD-API-KEY and DD-APPLICATION-KEY headers (remove this _notes field first).
